Build from source

Stable Windows reference: 0.4. Linux and additions listed below are preview features since 0.5; 0.5 is not stable yet. For the exact 0.4 behavior, see the 0.4 reference.

Build from source

Since 0.5: Debian package. Windows builds also apply to 0.4.

Use Rust 1.96 or newer, with the MSVC toolchain on Windows. Run cargo build --release to build the binaries and cargo test --workspace to run tests.

  • Windows installer: ./installer/build.ps1 builds target/installer/rosetun-<version>-setup.exe. See the installer instructions.
  • Debian package: installer/linux/build-deb.sh --release builds rosetun_<version>_amd64.deb, on Debian 13 or in Debian under WSL, as an ordinary user. See the same instructions.
  • Failure testing on virtual machines: the VM test rig.

Before committing, run git config core.hooksPath tools/hooks once. The hooks reject AI attribution and non-Conventional commit messages, patch files, real proxy hosts and your Windows account name in added lines, and unformatted code on push. CI runs the same message and added-line checks.
